initialFailure.scenario: Two authorized retries of the same invitation

correction.interpretation: The original report incorrectly described this as competing ownership claims. Existing application behavior intentionally accepts the retry without a second membership write or acceptance audit.
correction.subsequentFixtureFailure: The runner disables outbound email; the original test expected its mocked sender to run. The corrected test verifies the pause, then enables only its in-memory sender in a finally-restored environment scope.
